axis: Edge that compounds: each cycle strengthens without additional input. No flat moats.

questions.pattern: (compound|network effect|each new.+improves|fleet learning|knowledge graph (grows|compounds)|gets smarter|each cohort.+helps|each customer.+(reduces|improves) cost|data flywheel)
questions.question: REQUIRED: at least one explicit compounding loop named?

questions.pattern: (because each|the reason this compounds|the mechanism is|the loop works|every new .+ adds|every iteration|grows because)
questions.question: REQUIRED: mechanism by which the edge compounds is explained (not just claimed)?

questions.pattern: (\d+[- ]month (head start|window|lead)|\d+[- ]year (moat|advantage)|moat (closes|tightens|erodes)|catch-?up time|to replicate would require|window closes)
questions.question: REQUIRED: competitor catch-up timing or moat decay rate stated?

questions.pattern: \b(knowledge graph|fleet (data|learning|net)|customer base|installed base|brand equity|certifications|CMMC|patent portfolio|talent flywheel|content library|API ecosystem)\b
questions.question: REQUIRED: ≥2 named assets that compound (knowledge graph, fleet data, customer base, brand, certifications)?
REQUIRED: no 'we have first-mover advantage' without a compounding mechanism?

questions.pattern: (attach rate (grows|increases) from \d+%? to \d+%?|\$\d+M? by Y\d|ARR (grows|reaches) \$|\d+ OEMs? by Y\d|\d+% YoY)
questions.question: REQUIRED: compounding outcome is quantified ($/year, % growth, count growth)?
Optional: explicit claim that growth happens without additional input?

questions.pattern: (margin compression|moat (closes|erodes|dissipates)|catches up|fast[- ]follower position|cost of not moving|window closes by)
questions.question: Optional: negative compounding (cost of not moving) explicitly named?
